steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ptilopsis, you're back.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Thanks for going on that site inspection for me. I'm almost done with this experiment, so I'll be able to do the next one myself.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: It's okay.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I can go next time too.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Did something happen?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Yes. I'm going to my room now.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...Okay.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I think it should be in this diary...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: No, this one was written at Rhine Lab. So, it should be this one...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Yes, this one. This diary is from after I came to Rhodes Island with Silence.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Let me see.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: March 21 \ Overcast

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Today, two new operators came to the Island. One named Hung and one named Aak. They seem to be from the same place as Waai Fu.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: It is significant that Aak, who looks very young, is said to be a very famous back-alley doctor in Lungmen. But it seems he will not join the medical section.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: April 2 \ Cloudy

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Ever since he found out that Warfarin is 'Mr. Blood,' he has been visiting the medical section regularly.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: But most of the medical section does not like him. This is because he does nothing to conceal his disrespect for us as his peers.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: He is clearly highly skilled at healing Arts. Why...?

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: April 15 \ Sunny

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: ...Speaking of Aak, Hung came to take him away after his latest competition with Warfarin. He has since curbed his behavior somewhat.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: And the medical team is growing accustomed to his personality——at least outwardly.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: This diary must be from the time of his second 'duel' with Warfarin.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hey, 'Mr. Blood,' how about a little contest of skill?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Wow, what an obnoxious little wretch you are. Didn't you realize the power differential at work the last time you lost to me?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Are you serious? You think I lost that?

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Hey, Miss Feathers, you were there too. Who won that?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Silence, he means you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm Miss Feathers?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Analysis determines a 50% chance he is calling me. However, my logic functions have determined I do not want to respond to this form of address.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Neither do I.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: What are you whispering about? Come on, I didn't lose the last one, did I?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...Aak, we're busy. Please don't interrupt our work.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Sure, sure. I'm just asking a question. Give me an answer and I'll leave you to your noble 'work.'

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Very well. Accessing system records...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: According to the records, it is true that, objectively speaking, the winner of the last contest was difficult to determine, due to the unexpected circumstances arising at the end.

steps.name: Aak
steps.text: Well, how about that!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Pfft, fine. Let's give you a loss to remember today!

steps.name: Chatty Medic Operator
steps.text: *Sigh*. It's been like this every day since that Aak showed up. I really don't understand why the Doctor would hire someone like that...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Despite his abrasive personality, there is no denying that his clinical expertise, as well as his natural talent, is impressive.

steps.name: Chatty Medic Operator
steps.text: I know what you mean. But I think he looks down on us.

steps.name: Lively Medic Operator
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, that last surgery really impressed a lot of people, and I was kind of sold on him myself. I figured I'd try to make friends. He ended up treating me like garbage.

steps.name: Lively Medic Operator
steps.text: I hate that guy!

steps.name: Gossipy Medic Operator
steps.text: Only big boss Warfarin could get along with him.

steps.name: Chilly Medic Operator
steps.text: Is that what getting along looks like...? What do you think, Ptilopsis?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Searching dictionary database.... Result: birds of a feather flock together.

steps.name: Lively Medic Operator
steps.text: Hahaha, that works on a couple levels!

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: What's going on in here? Looks like you're having a good time.

steps.name: Gossipy Medic Operator
steps.text: Ah, Dr. Ansel, we were talking about Aak.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Oh.... I don't connect well with his personality, but it's nice to have a fresh face as skilled as him.

steps.name: Lively Medic Operator
steps.text: Leave it to Dr. Ansel to have nice things to say about Aak....

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: All right, even if we didn't have work to do, you can't be chatting it up during work hours. Back to your stations.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Right——

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You have something, Ansel?

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Well, I have the report. The results aren't exactly stellar.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That's more or less what we expected, though. Let's start preparing the next experiment right away.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ptilopsis, you go too.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Zzzzzzz.... Oh? Yes, understood.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Aak joining the medical section was a major upset to the order of things. And while there was some unpleasantness, I somehow did not dislike it...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Oh, I wrote, 'I did not dislike it' in this one.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: If I recall correctly, there should be more....

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Right, here it is.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: June 10 \ Light rain

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: The reconnaissance operators appear to have discovered a vein of Originium ore in a nearby mountain range, and Dr. Kal'tsit has sent a team to investigate.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: To be safe, Silence and a few medic operators went along.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Nothing else to do today but wait for test results.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: May 15 \ Sunny

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Gavial came back from an operation and told us at dinner that she grew so annoyed with the enemy scurrying around that she personally waded into battle and cut them all down.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: She seems to have forgotten that she is a medic operator. But she did make it sound appealing.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: May 1 \ Cloudy

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Today, after interviewing a new medic operator, I talked with Ansel about what we were doing before coming to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I couldn't reveal much of the inner workings of Rhine Lab to him due to confidentiality agreements, but it was a meaningful conversation.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Yes, this is it.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: In other words, you were also half patient and half researcher at Rhine Lab?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Yes, Silence has had me on a customized course of treatment from then until now.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: And Silence herself is Infected, and she has her own course.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Such things are not uncommon at Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: So Rhine Lab does a few things just like Rhodes Island. I always thought of Rhine Lab as a technology company.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Well, it's not a proactive approach to outreach like Rhodes Island's. I can't say more.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: But it is safe to assume that Rhine Lab cooperates with Rhodes Island in this area due to a shared outlook.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Then I guess it's my turn.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Hmmm.... There's not much to say. My hometown is in Rim Billiton, and since my family was poor, I never had much access to technology, or really anything new.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: After bouncing around a bit, I stumbled on a job listing for Rhodes Island. I put in a resume just to see what would happen, and here I am.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: It blew me away when I first got here. I never thought I'd ever get to work in a place like this.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Indeed. I did not think of Rhodes Island as a small land cruiser when Silence first discussed the cooperation agreement.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: But I've certainly learned a lot since coming here, and the remuneration is pretty good.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: It's a bit of a shame I can't get home to see my family more often though.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Family....

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Um, did I say something I shouldn't have?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: No. I'm just recalling my family from the database.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Load successful. So that's them. I had forgotten.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: ...It's hard, not seeing your family.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: It isn't.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Huh? It's not?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: It's not.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Never mind. Please, continue with your story, Ansel.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Oh, um, okay, I guess I can tell you about Rim Billiton.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Ansel spoke a lot about his homeland: the look of the mining town, his family, his sister, why he chose to become a doctor, and other such things.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I don't know why, but it felt a bit distant to me, like a memory of what my parents looked like...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Yes, everyone in the medical section talks about themselves on a regular basis. I am familiar with everyone's past. But for me, it is always a very distant thing.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Until then, I had thought it a very normal feeling.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: However, this is a problem that does exist.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Now then, it's time to write today's entry. It may be longer than usual this time.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: MM DD \ Overcast

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I finally returned to Rhodes Island after a rather long trip.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Although I occasionally travel with small teams, this time there were some additional circumstances that caused some difficulties.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Yes. Difficulties.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Zzzzz....
........Excuse me, Ptilopsis?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: .......! Was I sleeping?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Yes, I just need to tell you that we ran into a bit of a situation with the extraction and we need to recalibrate our tools.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Do you need my help?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: No, thanks. You've been a great help so far, Ptilopsis. It's a purely manual recalibration. No need to bother you.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: The captain just wanted you to know that the calibration may not be done today. If you're bored, there's a Kazimierz village not far from here, you could go for a stroll.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: It's the only mobile village in the area. It's not that small, and the scouts say there's a fair on today that might have some fun things.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Of course, if you want to keep resting here, that's fine too.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: ...Yes. I want to see it.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Sure. Here's a map, and some petty cash for you.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Sorry, we didn't really plan for this situation, so that's all the Kazimierz coinage we have.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Kazimierz... coinage?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Ah, well, while most places accept Lungmen dollars, they're not universal. Especially these villages outside of nomadic cities. They usually only take local currency.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: ...Yes, that sounds correct. There is some corroborating information in the database.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: All right, let's get going.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Oh. Are you going too?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Well, yes. This is a small operation, so we didn't establish a base camp, the main point being we can't use our communications equipment.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: That means, when somebody without combat capability wants to head out, she'll need an escort.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Not to mention, we all know your physical condition. You definitely can't be allowed out alone, for your own safety.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: This is the first time I have encountered this base camp information. Database update required.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Oh, you didn't know that?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: No, I rarely go out.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Oh, err, right. I shouldn't have brought it up, sorry...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Why are you apologizing?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Nothing. Never mind. Let's move out.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: In retrospect, he apologized to me because he felt he hadn't properly considered my health and had said something that could have hurt me.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: In fact, I didn't think of that at all at the time.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: And....

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Here, I encountered my first problem——It seems I do not know many things that others take for granted.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: No, it's not that I don't know, exactly. These things are in my database, but I have forgotten them because I haven't used them for so long.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Yes. I should adjust the wording.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Then, my second problem.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Kazimierz's scenery is quite different from Columbia's, or the view from the bridge of Rhodes Island. The air is clean, and vegetation plentiful.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Most of the villagers were Kuranta, but there were some of other races as well.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: The village fair was much busier than I expected.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: After a meeting with a logistics operator in charge of procurement, he showed me around and asked if I would like to buy anything.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I thought perhaps I could bring gifts for everyone in the medical section.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: What can I get you, Miss?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Hello, Miss?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: ...I don't know.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Huh? You want to buy something but you don't know what it is?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Ah, sorry, my companion is easily distracted.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: We want some local Kazimierz's goods.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: At that point, I realized my second problem. I do not know what everyone in the medical section enjoys.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: That isn't to say we don't have a good relationship. On the contrary, Dr. Silence and I should be good friends, according to the broad definition of the term.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: We've worked together extensively since our time at Rhine Lab, and she's the one who invited me to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: My relationships with the rest of the medic operators are amicable as well.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: But I don't know what they like.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I never thought about it.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: After that, we headed back to camp, and the rest of the expedition proceeded without incident.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: But on the way back, I began to think about something I had never realized was wrong.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Well.... Of course, I actually slept about half the trip.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: On the way to the village, I even fell asleep in the middle of the road.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: But to make for an easier read, I will omit those details.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Since joining Rhine Lab and transferring to Rhodes Island...?
Ptilopsis, open up!

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Ifrit, what are you doing here?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence is busy in the lab. I heard you were back so I came to see you.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: It's like, since you're pretty much always here, it was a lot weirder to have you gone. I'm used to Silence being out.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'm so glad you're back!

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Indeed, I rarely go out.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: ...Indeed, I rarely go out.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Why'd you say that twice, Ptilopsis?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: It just occurred to me that I don't actually go outside very often.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Huh? Did you hit your head out there?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: No, it was just some unknown error in the system. It has been fixed.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I bought some Kazimierz goods. They're over there.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Really! Let's see....

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Wow, this is a cool wooden sword.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hya! Whew! Shwing!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Check it out. Don't I look like one of those flippy Kurantas?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Eh.... Whatever. I still want it!

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: There is a storybook on the shelf. You can read it over there. I'm going to write something.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Sweet!

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Phew.... Now then.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: It's been a long time since I joined Rhine Lab and moved to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I'm completely used to the way things are now and subconsciously consider it normal.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: But this trip made me realize that's not the case.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Not that I reject the life I lead. I have just suddenly become aware of this problem.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: That is, I am myself quite far from normal.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Is 'normal' the correct word here? Is it my life that is abnormal?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: ...Broadly speaking, I suppose it is.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: And I simply forget.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Even I have a hard time describing what Oripathy has taken from me and given to me.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I can manage that once Silence worked out a treatment plan for me at Rhine Lab, research and sleep gradually took over my entire life.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: My body doesn't allow me to do time-consuming work, let alone leave the facility.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I am self-conscious about my condition, so even on the rare occasions that I do go outside, I do not move about so freely.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: For as long as I can remember, all my knowledge of the outside world has come almost entirely from the descriptions of my colleagues, various documents, and the unchanging view outside my window.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Now that I think about it, it's only natural that I would aspire to be like Gavial and Ansel.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: But before today, I did not realize why.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Because I can't help but compartmentalize myself when people discuss their lives.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I can engage with their topics, but I subconsciously think I don't belong in them.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Ptilopsis, what are you writing? Doesn't look like a report to me.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: A diary.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: A diary? Oh, Silence told me to keep one, but it was a huge pain!

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: True, it is a lot of work to write every day, but it is necessary for me.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: To keep myself from forgetting.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Why do you forget?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Because I am forgetful.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Um.... Don't get it.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: It is better if you don't.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh.... Can I see it?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: You can. But it is all text. I don't think you will like it.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Yeah, screw it. I'll go back to my storybook.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Now then, where was I...?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Silence, what's the matter? Something wrong in the lab?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Huh? Ah, no.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm just trying to figure out what to get Ifrit for her birthday. It's coming up.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: A birthday present?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes. It needs to be fireproof, and it needs to be something she likes. Ugh, a child's mind is so unpredictable.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I should just make something myself.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Nothing. I was just pondering how even Silence thinks about such things.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Is it that strange? Well... maybe it's a bit unlike me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But since I decided to take Ifrit with me, these things are my responsibility.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Even Silence, who can bury herself in her work for days on end, has such a side to her.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I understand that this is my own problem.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Or should I say, it was not a problem to begin with.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I don't feel so bad, because I do not dislike this researcher's life.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: On the other hand, if I hated research, I wouldn't have joined Rhine Lab at all.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Whether at Rhine Lab or Rhodes Island, I have seen countless people more miserable than I. And I'm lucky compared to them.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: And I believe that the research I'm doing is something meaningful.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: So, I'm not writing this as a lamentation, or to say that I've suddenly realized that I've been living the wrong kind of life.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I just remembered the purpose of my diary.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I hear strange noises from time to time, metal scraping, crashing, shouting, explosions.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: It's like these voices are coming from deep inside me, haunting me.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Sometimes when I wake up, I find myself in a sort of trance and I forget where I am and what I'm doing.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Of course, I don't really forget, but there's no denying that I'll need more time and energy to remember than a normal person would.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: I started this diary just to ensure I did not forget something important.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Something important....

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Ptilopsis, why are you staring at me? And what have you been mumbling to yourself all this time?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Did you get yourself into trouble? Do you need me to talk to Silence for you?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'll help you once, 'cause we're friends. You better not have done anything too bad. I don't need a spanking from Silence.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Hehe, don't worry.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Today's encounter made me realize something.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: When it comes to the important things, just trying not to forget them isn't enough.

steps.name: Diary
steps.text: Rather, I wish I could do more to understand the people I care about.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I don't want to regret anything.
Ptilopsis, is Ifrit with you?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hey, it's Silence!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ifrit didn't give you any trouble, did she?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: No, she was very good.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hehehe.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm glad. And are you okay? You seemed a bit off when you came back today.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I'm fine.... But, yes, I was just about to go looking for you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: For me?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Yes, I'd like to talk to you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Talk? Don't we always talk?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I'd like to... discuss a few things I've never thought about before.
